question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Just
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 1'. **i.e.** 'Unfair'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **"Just," **meaning fair or based on what is right (न्यायपूर्ण).
 
• The antonym is** "Unfair," **meaning not based on or behaving according to the principles of equality and justice (अन्यायपूर्ण).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Unfair'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: **"Gullible" **means easily persuaded to believe something (सीधा).
 
• Option 3:** "Honest" **means truthful and straightforward (ईमानदार).
 
• Option 4: **"Jovial" **means cheerful and friendly (हर्षित).
